Shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] '''arrested''' sixty-three [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the [[Delegation of 2000]], who were also signatories of the [[Petition of 2000]], which included senators [[Tanner Cadaman/Legends|Tanner Cadaman]], [[Ivor Drake/Legends|Ivor Drake]], [[Shea Sadashassa/Legends|Shea Sadashassa]], [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]], and [[Grebleips/Legends|Grebleips]]. The detained senators were charged with treason and conspiracy; accused of working with and supporting the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to attempt to overthrow [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="HoloNet" />

Such purges were expected by Bail Organa, who overtly threw his support behind Palpatine once it became clear that the Emperor had won for now. As such, he kept his post and influence, ready to work for the light when Sidious's scrutiny lapsed.<ref>[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' <small>(novelization)</small>]]</ref>
